verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents workflow automation, with flows and triggered events, so this axis applies to it. However, nothing in the pack shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. The developer sandbox account is a separate testing environment for apps, not version history or rollback for automations, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
